name: Autumn Willow
description: A forest spirit who gained sentience when Feroz isolated Ulgrotha and who tries to save the folk of An-Havva from Baron Sengir.

description_citations.text: "From the Library of Leng". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir speaks to Autumn Willow about forests of corpses; she answers about fallen trees nourishing seedlings.
timeline.quote: "Every forest is carpeted with the corpses of a thousand trees."

citation.text: Deathgrip (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Autumn Willow grows from a simple forest spirit into a sentient being with physical form because of the mana backed up by Feroz's Ban.
timeline.quote: the Autumn Willow grew incredibly powerful and achieved sentience and physical form

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Autumn Willow meets the first settlers, finds them good, and creates the Lady's Path for the Folk of An-Havva.
timeline.quote: She created for them the Lady's Path .

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Facing goblin raids, the Autumn Willow creates new guardians such as the Hungry Mist and faeries to watch over the wood.
timeline.quote: The Autumn Willow created new creatures from nothingness

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the evening Feroz died, the Autumn Willow has a prophetic vision of Baron Sengir leading an army through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir.
timeline.quote: On the evening that Feroz died, the Autumn Willow had a prophetic vision of Baron Sengir leading an army through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir .

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As Feroz's Ban begins to fail, the Autumn Willow feels her sustaining energies fade and agonizes over restarting the plane's mana channels at the cost of all creatures in the Homelands.
timeline.quote: When Feroz's Ban started to fail, she felt the energies that sustained her begin to fade.

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Autumn Willow creates the faerie noble Veldrane of Sengir, and the nobles take over the River Bridge in the Great Wood.
timeline.quote: The Autumn Willow created one of them in the form of Veldrane of Sengir .

citation.text: "Faerie", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz isolates Ulgrotha, giving Autumn Willow sentience; later Feroz's Ban fails and she tries to save the folk of An-Havva from Baron Sengir.
timeline.quote: gained sentience after the planeswalker Feroz isolated the plane of Ulgrotha from the rest of the Multiverse

citation.text: "From the Library of Leng", section "Caretaker of the Wood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: are believed to be the personal guardians of the Autumn Willow

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
